stories.title: UNC upsets TCU to open year two under Belichick
stories.summary: New quarterback Billy Edwards Jr. threw for 232 yards as North Carolina opened coach Bill Belichick's second season with a 15-10 win over TCU on a rainy Saturday in Ireland.

stories.title: Martina K's 12, Curaçao makes LLBWS title game
stories.summary: Jaymiëll Martina struck out 12 batters and added an RBI double to help Curaçao defeat Japan 4-0 on Saturday to advance to the Little League Baseball World Series title game.

stories.title: Cloud dismisses dustup with 'irrelevant' Freedom
stories.summary: The Sky's Natasha Cloud was dismissive of Enes Kanter Freedom, calling the former NBA player an "irrelevant person" while saying she is focused on issues that are "actually [affecting] women and children."

stories.title: Source: Bills cut Wishnowsky; Hardman also gone
stories.summary: The Bills are releasing veteran returner and wide receiver Mecole Hardman Jr. A source confirmed to ESPN that the team is also releasing punter Mitch Wishnowsky.

stories.title: Song KO's Nurmagomedov in massive UFC upset
stories.summary: Song Yadong pulled off a massive upset by knocking out heavily favored Umar Nurmagomedov in the men's bantamweight main event of UFC Fight Night in Shanghai.
